ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the cadence. When it matches a stored cadence, that cadence is updated. Otherwise a new cadence is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

DisplayText.description: Name of the cadence shown when it is selected on a loading campaign.

DelayMinutes.description: Minutes the contact must be silent since the automation's previous message before this nudge is sent. The clock restarts after each nudge.

IsAiGenerated.description: Whether the AI composes this nudge. When false, 'Message' is sent verbatim.

Message.description: The exact text sent when 'IsAiGenerated' is false (required in that case), or optional guidance the AI composes the nudge from when it is true.

Steps.description: Ordered nudges. The number of steps caps how many nudges are ever sent; an empty list never nudges.

Enabled.description: Whether the cadence is enabled. A disabled cadence never nudges.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the cadence, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Cadences.description: The re-engagement cadences to create or update.
